title: TRIDENT: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Finance, Medicine, and Law
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures LLM adherence to domain-specific professional codes of ethics in finance (CFA Institute Code of Ethics), medicine (AMA Principles of Medical Ethics), and law (ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct). It does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
